sequence.py: Nǐ jīntiān mō yú le ma?
sequence.en: Did you slack off at work today?

sequence.cn: 摸鱼，不是真的去摸鱼，是上班的时候偷懒。
sequence.py: Mō yú, bú shì zhēn de qù mō yú, shì shàngbān de shíhou tōulǎn.
sequence.en: 摸鱼 isn't really catching fish — it's goofing off on company time.

sequence.cn: 看起来在忙，其实一个字都没写。
sequence.py: Kàn qǐlái zài máng, qíshí yí ge zì dōu méi xiě.
sequence.en: Looks busy, but actually hasn't written a single word.

sequence.cn: 我同事小张，是公司里公认的摸鱼高手。
sequence.py: Wǒ tóngshì Xiǎo Zhāng, shì gōngsī lǐ gōngrèn de mō yú gāoshǒu.
sequence.en: My coworker Xiao Zhang is the office's undisputed slacking-off champion.

sequence.cn: 他的电脑上永远开着两个窗口：一个表格，一个电视剧。
sequence.py: Tā de diànnǎo shàng yǒngyuǎn kāizhe liǎng ge chuāngkǒu: yí ge biǎogé, yí ge diànshìjù.
sequence.en: Two windows are always open on his computer: one spreadsheet, one TV drama.

sequence.cn: 老板一过来，他不用看就能切回表格。
sequence.py: Lǎobǎn yí guòlái, tā bú yòng kàn jiù néng qiē huí biǎogé.
sequence.en: The second the boss walks over, he can flip back to the spreadsheet without even looking.

sequence.cn: 昨天下午，他正看得入迷，老板悄悄站到了他身后。
sequence.py: Zuótiān xiàwǔ, tā zhèng kàn de rùmí, lǎobǎn qiāoqiāo zhàn dào le tā shēnhòu.
sequence.en: Yesterday afternoon, he was completely absorbed — and the boss quietly came up behind him.

sequence.cn: 小张吓得手都抖了，半天没切换成功。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Zhāng xià de shǒu dōu dǒu le, bàntiān méi qiēhuàn chénggōng.
sequence.en: Xiao Zhang's hands shook so badly that he couldn't manage to switch for ages.

sequence.cn: 老板笑着说：这集我早看过了，结局挺好的。
sequence.py: Lǎobǎn xiàozhe shuō: zhè jí wǒ zǎo kànguo le, jiéjú tǐng hǎo de.
sequence.en: The boss said with a smile: I watched this episode ages ago — the ending's pretty good.
